(i) adaptive sampling is an essential ingredient for the convergence of derivative-free algorithms for stochastic optimization problems; (ii) the adaptive sampling strategy employed in ASTRO-DF can be applied to other derivative-free methods, e.g., trust-region and line-search methods; (iii) ASTRO-DF has the same almost-sure convergence rate as other trust-region methods for deterministic optimization problems; (iv) the adaptive sampling approach used in ASTRO- DF is not restricted to trust-region methods and
ASTRO- DF is a class of derivative- free algorithms for stochastic optimization, and that ASTRO- D F's iterates converge almost surely to a critical point.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of adaptive sampling strategies for derivative-free stochastic optimization.
the development and analysis of adaptive sampling methods for derivative-free stochastic optimization.

the development of a class of derivative free algorithms for stochastic optimization that are adaptive in the sense of sampling, while also achieving the canonical convergence rate of Monte Carlo methods for stochastic optimization.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the iterates of ASTRO- DF converge to a first-order stationary point almost surely, with a Monte Carlo convergence rate.

ASTRO- DF is a class of derivative free trust region algorithms with adaptive sampling, where the sampling is determined by balancing the sampling and structural error, and where the sampling is performed using a linear or quadratic interpolation model, which are shown to achieve the canonical Monte-Carlo convergence rate.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ASTRO- DF is a new adaptive class of derivative-free methods for stochastic optimization that can potentially achieve the canonical Monte Caro convergence rate.
ASTRO-DA is a novel class of adaptive stochastic derivative-free trust-region optimization methods with provable almost-sure convergence.
ASTRO- DF is the first class of derivative-free algorithms that can achieve the Monte Carlo canonical convergence rate for stochastic optimization.
The main takeaway from our work is that
adaptive Monte Carlo sampling can be incorporated within a trust-region framework to yield algorithms that are robust to sampling error.
adaptive Monte Carlo sampling can be incorporated into derivative-free algorithms to achieve almost-sure convergence to critical points of stochastic optimization problems.
the adaptive sampling strategy used in ASTRO-DF, which balances sampling error and model bias, is a promising approach for derivative-free stochastic optimization.
